== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Soulsmiths]] are specialized craftsmen who manipulate [[madra]] to work with the essence of spirits. Their primary role involves deconstructing and reconstructing [[Remnants]]—living forces left behind when powerful [[sacred artists]] die—to utilize their unique properties. Through this process, they can forge various items, including weapons, armor, prosthetic limbs, and complex [[constructs]]. Their work requires a deep understanding of how to blend the Soulsmith's own [[madra]] with specific bindings and materials, a delicate task where incompatibility can lead to dangerous failures. To perform their craft accurately, [[Soulsmiths]] utilize specialized tools such as drudges—mechanical [[constructs]] that assist in analyzing [[madra]] and [[Remnant]] components—and hammers, which are used to inject the smith's will into an object. They also employ complex [[scripts]] and [[spirit]]-seals to manage or weaken spiritual components. Training for this profession is a multi-year endeavor that demands exceptional memory, dedication to experimentation, and the ability to reshape [[madra]]. While their skills are not directly combat-oriented, [[Soulsmiths]] are highly valued assets to clans and sects, often serving as significant sources of income. Advanced [[Soulsmithing]] may involve using specialized locations like a [[Soulforge]] to imbue items with the authority of higher-tier existences.}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Soulsmiths]] are specialized craftsmen who work within a foundry to manipulate the essence of spirits. This discipline requires immense delicacy and skill when managing bindings, as well as a sharp memory and a dedication to constant experimentation. Through their craft, they forge weapons, form various [[constructs]], and even steal bindings from [[Remnants]] to transplant them into [[sacred artists]]. Furthermore, a master of this art is capable of controlling many different [[constructs]] simultaneously.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|A [[Soulsmith]] works in a foundry.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c10">''Soulsmith'', chapter 10</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Soulsmithing]] is a discipline that requires delicacy and skill to work with bindings.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c11">''Soulsmith'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Soulsmiths]] are craftsmen who work with the stuff of spirits.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c12">''Soulsmith'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|A Soulsmith is a professional title for those who practice the art of soulsmithing, which involves reshaping [[madra]] other than one's own to give power a specific form. This process of creating [[constructs]] requires compatibility between the practitioner's power and that of the object being formed, often utilizing goldsteel for specialized tools. Practitioners like Gesha employ these techniques, and a Soulsmith may even be responsible for managing the operations of a course. Furthermore, these individuals possess the ability to perform various tasks using a [[Sylvan Riverseed]] and may maintain an underground storehouse for their work.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">9</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|[[Soulsmithing]] is the process of creating a [[construct]] by taking control of power and giving it form.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c1" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|[[Soulsmithing]] requires compatibility between the [[Soulsmith]]'s power and the [[construct]]'s power.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c1" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|[[Soulsmith]] is a title or profession.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c2">''Blackflame'', chapter 2</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Gesha uses [[Soulsmith]] practice.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c6">''Blackflame'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Reshaping [[madra]] besides one's own is the fundamental skill of a [[Soulsmith]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|[[Soulsmiths]] can do many things with a [[Sylvan Riverseed]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c10">''Blackflame'', chapter 10</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|There is a [[Soulsmith]]’s underground storehouse.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c17">''Blackflame'', chapter 17</ref>}}</li>
